Subject: Discovery recap & MAP next steps

Hi Emma —

Great to meet today. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

Summary of needs
- Clinical search + chart summarization for oncology workflows
- Low-latency inference (<=150ms p95) for UI interactions
- Data residency in US, SOC2 + custom audit log requirements

Proposed MAP (high level) — happy to expand into a milestone table in the attached draft:
1) Week 1 (by 2026-03-17): Share MAP draft + SOW (owner: Redwood - Marissa)
2) Week 2 (by 2026-03-24): Technical deep-dive & perf targets (owner: Acuity + Redwood SE - Aditya)
3) Week 3 (by 2026-03-31): Pilot onboarding + test dataset (owner: Acuity)
4) Week 6 (target close by 2026-04-21): Production handoff / Exec sign-off (owner: Acuity + Redwood)

Dependencies / open items
- Procurement: required signatory & expected PO timeline
- Security: SOC2 report + clarifications on audit log retention
- Volume/commit: need rough 12-month commit to firm pricing

Next steps
- I’ll send a MAP draft and initial SOW by EOD tomorrow (attached). Please confirm the target close date and any additional stakeholders (procurement/legal).

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

- Target close: our execs are aiming for late April (week of 2026-04-20). The MAP timelines you suggested look reasonable but we need the MAP to show milestones, owners, and acceptance criteria so we can route internally.
- Procurement: I’ve looped in procurement (copied). Our standard procurement timeline is ~3 weeks after SOW + pricing is finalized.

Subject: Fwd: RE: Discovery recap & MAP next steps — Pricing approval needed

Vivek —

Forwarding the MAP and SOW drafts from the Acuity engagement. They asked for two commit-based pricing options and specifically flagged the need to consider onboarding credits if we want to compete with incumbents. Quick summary / ask below: 

Deal: Acuity Health (RDW-2026-0137)
- Proposed target close: 2026-04-21
- Baseline pricing: 12-month and 24-month tiers included in SOW (see appendix).
- Proposed concession: 15% one-time discount on implementation fees + $25k onboarding credit if Acuity commits to the 12-month $600k ARR equivalent (details in SOW).
- Rationale: competitive displacement vs incumbent + potential for expansion across 3 other lines of business within 6 months.
- Risk: SOC2 clarifications and procurement timeline could push close out 2-3 weeks.

Request: Exec approval for the proposed concession (15% + $25k credit) and authorization to offer this conditional on a signed 12-month commitment and PO within 30 days of SOW sign-off.

I’ve highlighted the exact SOW sections in the attached doc. If you prefer, I can raise through pricing portal but wanted to get quick alignment before doing that.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Thanks Marissa — reviewed the MAP and SOW. I’m okay to approve the concession with conditions: 

1) Approve 15% one-time discount on implementation fees + $25k onboarding credit contingent on a 12-month minimum revenue commit of $600k (must be in SOW and reflected in HubSpot deal).
2) Require signature from Acuity CFO or Director of Finance on the SOW and a PO issued within 30 days of signature.
3) Offer the credit as a timebound execution credit (applies to first invoice only).

Please update the SOW language to include those clauses, attach the final SOW to the HubSpot deal (https://hubspot.com/deal/2871), and capture the MAP milestone for procurement sign-off window. Once updated, you have permission to negotiate within these guardrails.
